'''Wang Kui''' ({{zh|c=王夔|p=Wáng Kuí}}; 7 May 1928 – 6 July 2025) was a Chinese inorganic chemist who was a professor at [[Peking University Health Science Center]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Xu Luyi ({{lang|zh|徐路易}}) |url=https://mini.caixin.com/2025-07-09/102339487.html |script-title=zh:一生三次科研转向，中国生物无机化学奠基人王夔院士逝世，97岁 |work=caixin.com |date=2025-07-09 |access-date=2025-07-27 |language=zh}}</ref> He was a member of the 7th, 8th and 9th National Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].<ref name="ab">{{cite news |editor1=Yan Ru ({{lang|zh|晏如}}) |url=https://news.pku.edu.cn/xwzh/8658a49485904579949144a044a15f4c.htm |script-title=zh:深情送别王夔院士 |work=pku.edu.cn |date=2025-07-11 |access-date=2025-07-27 |language=zh}}</ref>  

== Biography ==
Wang was born in [[Tianjin]], on 7 May 1928, and graduated from [[Yenching University]] and [[Peking University]].<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee">{{cite news |author1=Jin Haotian ({{lang|zh|晋浩天}}) |url=https://topics.gmw.cn/2025-07/07/content_38138570.htm |script-title=zh:无机化学家王夔院士逝世 |work=gmw.cn |date=2025-07-07 |access-date=2025-07-27 |language=zh}}</ref>

After graduation in 1952, Wang taught at the Pre-medical course of Peking University, and moved to the Department of Pharmacy, Beijing Medical College (now [[Peking University Health Science Center]]) a year later.<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/> He was promoted to director in 1983 and full professor and dean of the School of Pharmacy in 1985.<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/> In 1993, he became director of the Chemical Sciences Division, National Natural Science Foundation of China, a post he kept until 1998.<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/> 

On 6 July 2025, Wang died in Beijing, at the age of 97.<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/>
* 2000 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="ab"/><ref name="bee"/>
